html:
Saudi Aramco is the national oil company of Saudi Arabia and one of the largest and most profitable companies in the world. It began in 1933 as a concession that Ibn Saud granted to Standard Oil of California.

American geologists struck oil in commercial amounts at Dammam well number 7 in 1938. The venture took the name Arabian American Oil Company in 1944, and other American oil majors bought in. It found the Ghawar field, the largest conventional oil field ever found, and built the Trans-Arabian Pipeline to the Mediterranean.

Aramco built towns, roads and hospitals in the Eastern Province and trained a Saudi workforce. After the 1973 oil embargo showed Arab oil power, the Saudi state bought the company in steps and owned it fully by 1980. It became Saudi Aramco in 1988.

A small share of the company was listed on the Riyadh stock market in 2019, then the largest share sale in history. Its revenue pays for most of the Saudi state, part of the story told at the Anglo-Persian Oil Company and OPEC.
sum: Saudi Aramco is the national oil company of Saudi Arabia and one of the largest and most profitable companies in the world. It began in 1933 as a concession that Ibn Saud granted to Standard Oil of California.
